svg.text: Motor 16T → 188 mm closed loop → 80T on the shaft → 20T on the same shaft → the Z belt that lifts the gantry. gear_ratio: 80:16.

svg.text: Z gearing is stock: the LDO Klipper config carries [stepper_z] rotation_distance: 40 and gear_ratio: 80:16. Four identical drives, two 'a' and two 'b'. The Z idler's pulley must face the same way as the 20T in the drive directly below it, or the Z belt does not run in one plane.
